basics.name: Rob O'Dwyer
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer: AI Engineering & Cloud Infrastructure
basics.summary: Software engineer with 15+ years of experience spanning startup CTO, Principal Engineer at Workday, and independent infrastructure consulting.

work.name: Whalesync
work.summary: Owned multiple product and infrastructure projects end to end.
highlights: Migrated sync integrations to new infra using an AI-assisted harness with automated validation of production data
Researched and developed generative AI-powered features to streamline the experience of setting up a Whalesync sync

work.name: Independent Consultant
work.summary: Led cloud-based infrastructure migrations for three startups
highlights: Migrated Whalesync's production and staging infrastructure from AWS to GCP with no downtime
Built an automated deploy pipeline on AWS for WATS
Built automated deploy pipelines and observability tooling for OtherSphere

work.name: DevCycle
work.summary: Implemented SDKs in multiple languages, built new features for the DevCycle feature flag platform, and maintained DevCycle and Taplytics infrastructure
highlights: Worked closely with a large customer to optimize the Go SDK for their low-latency usecase, and succeeded in achieving the goal of sub 50 nanosecond 90th percentile lookups in production.
Built automated release pipelines on Github Actions for Go, Python, Javascript, and Java SDKs to maximize platform compatibility.

work.name: Battlesnake
work.summary: Responsible for developing and scaling of Battlesnake game engine server and global proxy system.
highlights: Built out a global multi-datacenter proxy system to calculate player latency more equitably.
Engaged with the active Battlesnake developer community through open source and community discussions.

work.name: Workday
work.summary: Developed cloud services for processing video and interactive learning content
highlights: Led the migration of a production service along with customer data from the Workday datacenter to AWS.
Set up and trained a new developer team in Dublin, Ireland.

work.name: Pretio Interactive
work.summary: Part of the founding team and responsible for developing Pretio's core technology and growing the development team. Pretio Interactive was an ad-tech startup that combined machine learning and consumer preferences to serve personalized ads.
highlights: Recruited and trained development team while building the technology platform for Pretio's advertising network.
Designed and built a high throughput HTTP server in Go for integrating into real-time bidding networks, and successfully scaled it to operate at 10K requests/second.
Researched and implemented online machine learning techniques to optimize profitability.

work.name: Entrepreneurship@Alacrity
work.summary: The Entrepreneurship@Alacrity program provided an intense training environment to prepare graduates for entrepreneurship in the technology sector.
highlights: Worked with founding team of RewardsDen to develop the team and technology that later became Pretio Interactive.

work.name: Co-op Program Positions
work.summary: Completed multiple co-op placements during undergraduate studies at UBC.
highlights: PDFTron: Developed an HTML5 / Javascript PDF viewer.
Dolby Laboratories: Research into color mapping algorithms with Matlab and C.
BC Children's Hospital: Developed a Java plugin to interface with a medical device.
